title: Mind-Blowing! Anthropic's Revenue Surges 13 Times in One Quarter and Achieves Profitability: Has the Era of AI Large Models Being Purely Money-Burning Come to an End?
excerpt: Recent pessimistic narratives about the endless investment required for the development of large-scale artificial intelligence models are being completely overt
content_html:
Recent pessimistic narratives about the endless investment required for the development of large-scale artificial intelligence models are being completely overturned by the latest financial reports from leading companies. As one of the world's top artificial intelligence companies, Anthropic recently disclosed financial data to potential investors showing breakthrough progress in its commercialization process.

The documents show that Anthropic's preliminary revenue for the most recent full quarter has exceeded $11.5 billion, a growth of more than 13 times compared to $787 million in the same period last year, and the revenue for the first quarter of this year was $4.73 billion. More importantly, with the concentrated release of enterprise customers' willingness to pay, the company's adjusted operating profit for the second quarter of 2026 has turned positive, demonstrating a very strong ability to generate cash flow. Meanwhile, insiders have revealed that the company expects its total revenue to surge to between $190 billion and $200 billion by 2028.

文件显示，Anthropic最近一个完整季度的初步营收已超过115亿美元，与去年同期的7.87亿美元相比增长了13倍以上，而今年第一季度的营收为47.3亿美元。 更重要的是，随着企业客户支付意愿的集中释放，公司2026年第二季度调整后营业利润转正，展现出非常强的现金流产生能力。 与此同时，内部人士透露，该公司预计到 2028 年其总收入将飙升至 1900 亿至 2000 亿美元。
